To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
anti-ADM antibodies directed against the N-terminal epitope are effective in a CLP murine sepsis model.
an antibody directed against the ADM N-terminus is more potent to reduce mortality than antibodies directed against the ADM C-terminus or the ADM receptor.
an anti-ADM antibody with an affinity of 0.5 nM and an epitope specificity directed against the N-terminal region of ADM substantially increases survival in a CLP mice model.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of anti-ADM antibodies as a new class of compounds for the treatment of septic shock.
the development of a new therapeutic concept for the treatment of sepsis.
a novel strategy for the development of anti-ADM antibodies that may be beneficial for the treatment of septic shock.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the epitope specificity of the anti-ADM antibodies determines their efficacy in a CLP sepsis model.
the epitope specificity of anti-adrenomedullin antibody is an important determinant for the efficacy of mortality reduction of septic mice in the cecal ligation model.
the epitope specificity of anti-adrenomedullin antibody determines its efficacy in the treatment of sepsis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
antibodies with different epitopes and different affinities can have a different efficacy.
the epitope specificity of anti-adrenomedullin antibody is critical in the development of new compounds for treatment or prevention of severe sepsis and septic shock.
the ADM system can be influenced by antibodies, but that the epitope specificity determines the effect of these antibodies.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the epitope specificity of anti-adrenomedullin monoclonal antibodies is crucial for their efficacy and that antibodies directed against the N-terminal region of the peptide are most promising for the treatment and prevention of sepsis.
epitope specificity is a critical determinant for the efficacy of ADM antagonism.
the epitope specificity of anti-peptide antibodies is an important determinant of the efficacy of anti-peptide antibody-based therapeutics.
